releaseNotes:
• Fix: Stop Endless Normal-Scene Skipping in Movies — removed generic movie/nudity MobileCLIP prompt tokens that fired 0.856 on black/transition screens (now 0.0003 on black & dark UI), added visual luma/variance guard, required human face/person presence + 2-frame confirmation when faces aren't locked together, and discarded stale in-flight CLIP jobs across +10s skips.
• Fix: Stop Facebook Feed & Reels False Auto-Scroll — narrowed REEL_VIEW_HINTS so Home Feed "Reels" tabs don't trigger REELS_SHORT, stopped auto-scroll/back on social home feeds while keeping real-time blur active, and tightened Reels CLIP corroboration.
